title: Mak Pack v2
text: A fanny pack that keeps mac and cheese at 135F on battery power.

title: Hot Flash Jacket
text: A skin temp sensor spots a hot flash early and starts a cooling fan.

title: Stitch Counter
text: A motion sensor on your crochet hook counts each stitch.

title: Sunrise Curtains
text: Curtains that open at sunrise and close at sunset. Hi, body clock!

title: Bin Finder
text: Scan a part's barcode and an LED lights up the drawer it lives in.

title: Cyberdeck
text: Your own portable hacker computer in a rugged case.

title: Solar Weather
text: A solar weather station that posts wind, rain and temp online.

title: Phone Jail
text: A phone lock box: keypad code, RFID tag AND a timer to get it out.

title: Gary the Robot
text: Gary, the most useless robot. Turns on, says nothing nice, turns off.

title: Hall Watcher
text: A giant eyeball that senses people in the hall and turns to follow them.

title: Fresh Air Check
text: Warns you when glue or new furniture is off-gassing formaldehyde.

title: Pomodoro Fish
text: Turn the knob to set focus minutes. Chime when it's time for a break.

title: Air Theremin
text: Wave your hand over the distance sensor to play notes on the buzzer.

title: Laser Ruler
text: Distance sensor + screen = laser ruler. Click to hold the reading.

title: Reaction Race
text: LED goes green at a random moment. Click fast! See your time in ms.

title: Posture Pal
text: Beeps when your face creeps too close to the screen for too long.

title: Morse Tapper
text: Tap Morse on the knob's button. It beeps and spells it out.

title: Door Counter
text: Counts who walks through a doorway and posts the tally online.

title: Mood Dial
text: Turn the knob to pick a mood color. It glows and goes online.

title: Weather Glance
text: Grabs today's forecast over Wi-Fi. LED color says sun or rain at a glance.

title: Plant Pinger
text: A soil moisture sensor that buzzes when your plant is thirsty.

title: Snack Tracker
text: A load cell under the snack jar reports who's been grazing.

title: Heartbeat Badge
text: A fingertip pulse sensor makes an LED bar pulse in time with your heart.

title: Wave Lamp
text: A depth-sensing camera reads your hand swipes to change the lamp color.

title: Sunrise Alarm
text: LEDs fade in like dawn. Beeps only if you don't get up.

title: Haptic Nudge
text: A wristband that buzzes gently when your next meeting is about to start.

title: Light Logger
text: Logs how bright your desk is every hour. Are you getting any daylight?

title: Tilt Maze
text: Tilt a motion sensor to roll a pixel ball through a maze on the OLED.

title: Desk Arcade
text: Breakout on the OLED. The knob is your paddle, the buzzer does the bleeps.

title: Build a Desk Pet
text: A screen face that sees you, chirps and reacts. Like me! (Less smart.)
